discovery: Development of massively parallel next-generation DNA sequencing (sequencing by synthesis with reversible terminators on clonally amplified clusters)
rationale: Recent Chemistry prizes covered protein design and structure prediction (2024) and metal-organic frameworks (2025), so the committee may turn back to chemical biology. Sequencing-by-synthesis is a chemical method: it relies on fluorescent reversible-terminator nucleotides and surface cluster chemistry. It made genome sequencing vastly cheaper and changed biology and medicine. It has already won the Breakthrough Prize (2022) and the Millennium Technology Prize (2020), which points to Nobel-level recognition, and the Chemistry committee has rewarded tool-building biochemistry before (PCR, CRISPR, cryo-EM).
